settings.feedback: Previous source and current-stage execution/schema error only; no hidden labels, hidden scores, or reference source.
settings.stopping: Stop a job after two candidate failures in one stage. Stop unresolved infrastructure/provider/version failures without automatic new API calls.
settings.reason: Earlier pilots failed on nullable missing values or exhausted completion budgets. Clarify a common artifact contract and give all models the same finite budget, rather than changing validators or repairing model code manually.
settings.case_reuse: P0 cases are reused for interface debugging. These are not new independent datasets and are not pooled with earlier prompt revisions.
settings.ability_rank: Single-model harness placeholder only; previous microtask ranks are not ecological calibration.
settings.cost_units: Provider-reported response-cost units; currency/pricing unconfirmed. Include failed attempts.
